info.name: Get Best Times to Post for Account

params.name: account_id
params.description: Social media account ID to analyze posting times for. When provided, analysis is specific to this account's performance data

params.name: competitors
params.description: Include competitor data in best times analysis. Set to 'true' to analyze competitor posting patterns

params.name: competitor_id
params.description: Specific competitor ID to analyze. Used in conjunction with competitors=true parameter

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for analytics data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters data from this date onwards

params.name: to
params.description: End date for analytics data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters data up to this date

items.docs: Retrieves the optimal posting times for a specific social media account based on historical analytics data. Returns a heatmap of posting performance across days of the week and hours of the day, tailored to the specified account's audience engagement patterns.

params.name: account_type
params.description: Social media platform type to filter charts for (e.g., 'ig_business', 'fb_page', 'twitter', 'linkedin', 'youtube', 'tiktok', 'google', 'pin_business')

items.docs: Retrieves a list of available analytics charts filtered by account type and chart type. Charts include growth metrics (followers, connections), insights (engagement, reach), and demographics (countries, ages).

params.name: chart_ids
params.description: Array of chart IDs to retrieve data for. Use chart IDs from the /analytics/charts endpoint

params.name: account_id
params.description: Optional account ID to filter analytics data for a specific social media account

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for analytics data (YYYY-MM-DD format)

params.name: to
params.description: End date for analytics data (YYYY-MM-DD format)

items.docs: Retrieves analytics data for specific charts by their IDs. Returns current and previous period data for comparison. Supports growth metrics, post insights, and demographic data.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for hashtag insights data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters posts scheduled on or after this date

params.name: to
params.description: End date for hashtag insights data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters posts scheduled on or before this date

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort hashtag results by. Supports various engagement and performance metrics

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort order direction

params.name: account_id
params.description: Filter hashtags for a specific social media account ID. If omitted, includes all workspace accounts

params.name: page
params.description: Page number for pagination (0-based indexing). Each page contains 10 hashtags

params.name: query
params.description: Search query to filter hashtags by name using case-insensitive matching

params.name: member_id
params.description: Filter hashtags by specific workspace member ID

items.docs: Retrieves comprehensive analytics data for hashtags used in published posts. Provides metrics like reach, engagement, likes, comments, shares, and video views for each hashtag, along with recent posts using each hashtag and hashtag performance scores.

params.name: hashtag
params.description: The hashtag to retrieve performing posts for (with # symbol). This parameter is required to filter posts by the specific hashtag

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for posts data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters posts scheduled on or after this date

params.name: to
params.description: End date for posts data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters posts scheduled on or before this date

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Field to sort post results by. Supports various engagement and performance metrics

params.name: sort_type
params.description: Sort order direction

params.name: account_id
params.description: Filter posts for a specific social media account ID. If omitted, includes all workspace accounts

params.name: member_id
params.description: Filter posts by specific workspace member ID

params.name: query
params.description: Search query to filter posts by content text, title, or link information using case-insensitive matching

items.docs: Retrieves the top performing posts for a specific hashtag. Returns up to 6 posts that used the hashtag, with comprehensive analytics metrics including engagement, reach, likes, comments, shares, and video views.

params.name: from
params.description: Start date for analytics data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters data from this date onwards

params.name: to
params.description: End date for analytics data range (YYYY-MM-DD format). Filters data up to this date

params.name: account_id
params.description: Optional account ID to filter analytics data for a specific social media account

items.docs: Retrieves analytics data for workspace members showing their posting activity and engagement metrics.

params.name: postType
